title: Moral Conviction: Another Contributor to Attitude Strength or Something More?

publication.publisher_or_container: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, Vol. 88, No. 6

verification.verification_notes: Bibliographic record and abstract confirmed via PubMed/APA PsycNet and the published PDF mirror; three studies show moral mandates uniquely predict preferred social and physical distance from attitudinally dissimilar others after controlling for attitude strength.
